plugins.name: observability
plugins.description: Role entry point on contract v3 (issue-7 scope narrowing): role-level directive naming what this role decides/hands off and pointing at the methodology and cross-cutting plugins below. Signal-methodology and cross-cutting produces norms live in the plugins listed next, not here.

plugins.name: observability-methodology-selector
plugins.description: Phase-1 methodology-selection procedure: classify each surface (request-driven/resource-bound/service-rollup) and name exactly one signal methodology (RED/USE/Golden Signals) — does not implement any signal methodology itself.

plugins.name: observability-signal-red
plugins.description: RED (Rate/Errors/Duration) for request-driven surfaces only. Phase-2 only: requires all three signals named with a concrete instrumentation point each.

plugins.name: observability-signal-use
plugins.description: USE (Utilization/Saturation/Errors) for resource-bound surfaces only. Phase-2 only: requires all three signals named with a concrete instrumentation point each.

plugins.name: observability-signal-golden
plugins.description: Golden Signals (Latency/Traffic/Errors/Saturation) for service-rollup surfaces only. Phase-2 only: requires all four signals named with a concrete instrumentation point each.

plugins.name: observability-cardinality-budget
plugins.description: Methodology-agnostic cross-cutting norm: high-cardinality dimension list (preliminary at phase-1, confirmed + handling policy at phase-2) with placeholder-rejection.

plugins.name: observability-explorability
plugins.description: Methodology-agnostic cross-cutting norm: keep the instrumentation queryable for un-predefined questions (phase-1 one-line check, phase-2 requires a concrete ad-hoc query example).

plugins.name: observability-phase-trace
plugins.description: Methodology-agnostic cross-cutting norm: phase-2's adopted methodology must trace to what phase-1 named — ordering constraint tracked as state, consumed here, written by observability-methodology-selector.
